items.source: @Conditional that checks whether tracing is enabled. It matches if the value of the management.tracing.export.enabled property is true or if it is not configured. If the tracing exporter name is set, the management.tracing.export.<name>.enabled property can be used to control the behavior for the specific tracing exporter. In that case, the exporter specific property takes precedence over the global property.
items.translation: @Conditional 用于检查是否启用了跟踪。如果 management.tracing.export.enabled 属性的值为 true 或未配置，则匹配。如果设置了 跟踪导出器名称，可以使用 management.tracing.export.<name>.enabled 属性来控制特定跟踪导出器的行为。在这种情况下，特定于导出器的属性优先于全局属性。

items.source: the name of the tracing exporter
